tagline.en_US: A web-based administration and development tool for PostgreSQL. It can run as a standalone service with its own configuration database; connect it to PostgreSQL servers when you are ready to manage them.

description.en_US: pgAdmin 4 is an administration and development platform for PostgreSQL databases. It provides an interface to manage database objects, execute queries, and monitor server operations. It can be deployed as a web application accessible via a browser or run locally as a desktop program.
